title: ISO 20816-1:2026 — Mechanical vibration measurement and evaluation, Part 1
version: ISO 20816-1:2026, Edition 2; publication month 2026-10; replaces ISO 20816-1:2016
locator: Official ISO catalogue scope and lifecycle information
notes: General principles for vibration measurements on complete machines and evaluation for operational monitoring/acceptance. Does not apply to torsional vibration and does not cover axial shaft vibration unless otherwise stated; vibration criteria for specific machine types are in other parts. Not a rotary-axis positioning or torque-ripple acceptance standard.
